name: CustomerContacts
technicalDescription: Read-only mirror of contacts on the Priority customer card. Used to verify email senders (statements only go to registered contacts) and as step 2 of payer identification.

columns.name: contactKey
columns.description: Unique contact key (customerCode + contact id in Priority)

columns.name: customerCode
columns.description: Priority customer code (text link to Customers)

columns.name: roleFlags
columns.description: Roles, comma-separated from: הנהלת חשבונות, רכש, ראשי, אחר

columns.name: source
columns.description: Data source: priority-mock, priority-file (uploaded Priority export), priority-api, or test-fixture (marked test data, removed by DeleteTestFixtures)

columns.name: syncedAt
columns.description: When this row was last loaded from Priority / the bank file

columns.name: isApContact
columns.description: The customer's accounts-payable (הנהלת חשבונות) contact: detail requests for unexplained transfers go to this person. From Priority (whether Priority maintains this flag is open with Yaniv); writers always set it

columns.name: signatureTitle
columns.description: Plan 04.11 part C: job title from the mail signature of a sender we added

columns.name: addedFromEmailId
columns.description: InboundEmails id the contact was confirmed from (source נוסף אצלנו); the Priority pull never touches these rows

columns.name: priorityKey
columns.description: Mirror key from Priority (see table description); null on rows the app added

columns.name: syncRunId
columns.description: SyncRuns.runId of the SyncPrioritySubforms run that last wrote the row

columns.name: deletedInSource
columns.description: True when a full read of this scope no longer found the row in Priority; never deleted
